business_summary: Hemp-extract CBD brand offering gummies, oils, and creams priced between $40 and $90, targeting stress relief, sleep support, and exercise recovery.
product: Hemp-extract CBD gummies, oil and creams
stated_claims: Hemp-extract CBD gummies, oil and creams

relevant_tags.why: CBD gummies and oils are ingested dietary supplements for health and wellness.
CBD products are core offerings in the direct-to-consumer wellness space.
CBD creams are topical applications adjacent to skincare and body care.
Gummies and oils are frequently purchased by vitamin consumers.
Hemp-extract is a plant-derived natural ingredient.

persona_conflicts.evidence: $40-90 a bottle is a premium price point that conflicts with value-conscious shoppers.

note_signals.why: Fitness-engaged shoppers are highly aligned with the exercise recovery use case.
Users actively spending on self-care and fitness align well with stress, sleep, and recovery products.
Science-forward audience skeptical of unsubstantiated health claims may reject CBD claims without clinical backing.

gate_reason: The product, price point, and target use cases are clearly defined, allowing for immediate planning. Platform restrictions on CBD can be managed programmatically.
clarifying_questions: Do you offer a subscription model for your CBD products?
Are your products third-party lab tested or certified organic?
Are there any specific US states you cannot ship your CBD products to?
